parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Sets the retention policy as default retention policy. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Determines how long InfluxDB should keep the data. If specified, it should be INF or at least one hour. If not specified, INF is assumed. Supports complex duration expressions with multiple units. Required only if state is set to present.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address on which InfluxDB server is listening. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server. Default: "root"

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path on which InfluxDB server is accessible. Only available when using python-influxdb >= 5.1.0. Default: ""

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which InfluxDB server is listening. Default: 8086

parameters.name: proxies
parameters.description: HTTP(S) proxy to use for Requests to connect to InfluxDB server. Default: {}

parameters.name: replication
parameters.description: Determines how many independent copies of each point are stored in the cluster. Required only if state is set to present.

parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: Number of retries client performs before aborting. 0 indicates try until success. Only available when using python-influxdb >= 4.1.0. Default: 3

parameters.name: shard_group_duration
parameters.description: Determines the time range covered by a shard group. If specified it must be at least one hour. If not provided, it is determined by InfluxDB by the rentention policy’s duration. Supports complex duration expressions with multiple units.

parameters.name: ssl
parameters.description: Use https instead of http to connect to InfluxDB server. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the retention policy. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Number of seconds Requests waits for client to establish a connection.

parameters.name: udp_port
parameters.description: UDP port to connect to InfluxDB server. Default: 4444

parameters.name: use_udp
parameters.description: Use UDP to connect to InfluxDB server. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server. Default: "root"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
# Example influxdb_retention_policy command from Ansible Playbooks
- name: Create 1 hour retention policy
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    duration: 1h
    replication: 1
    ssl: true
    validate_certs: true
    state: present

- name: Create 1 day retention policy with 1 hour shard group duration
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    duration: 1d
    replication: 1
    shard_group_duration: 1h
    state: present

- name: Create 1 week retention policy with 1 day shard group duration
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    duration: 1w
    replication: 1
    shard_group_duration: 1d
    state: present

- name: Create infinite retention policy with 1 week of shard group duration
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    duration: INF
    replication: 1
    ssl: false
    shard_group_duration: 1w
    state: present

- name: Create retention policy with complex durations
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    duration: 5d1h30m
    replication: 1
    ssl: false
    shard_group_duration: 1d10h30m
    state: present

- name: Drop retention policy
  community.general.influxdb_retention_policy:
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_ip_address }}"
    database_name: "{{ influxdb_database_name }}"
    policy_name: test
    state: absent
